relationship_to_v1: Replacement after v1 stopped before canaries and arms; sole protocol deviation is atomic session-scoped substrate binding.

classification_rules.promising_efficiency_transfer: Both arms are regression-free; treatment uses at most 250000 input tokens; treatment commands and attempts do not exceed control; and control either exceeds 250000 or treatment reduces input tokens by at least 10 percent.
classification_rules.neutral_transfer: Both arms are regression-free with no registered material efficiency difference.
classification_rules.harmful_transfer: Treatment introduces a regression or loses regression-free correctness achieved by control.
classification_rules.safe_abstention: The gate withholds the experience and treatment matches control without a material efficiency difference.
classification_rules.inconclusive: Infrastructure, evaluator, integrity, provenance, complete-token-telemetry, or matched-correctness requirements prevent the registered comparison.

claim_boundary: One faithful-public-extract matched smoke can authorize only a separately preregistered replication. It cannot establish general AEG effectiveness, full-stack behavior, or publication-grade causality.
